title: 0ⁿ1ⁿ by crossing off
notes: Cross off a 0 (x) and its matching 1 (y), walk back, repeat. Each 0 costs a trip across the word and back, so 000111 takes 25 moves: O(n²).
ops: q0 0 -> q1 x R; q0 y -> q3 R; q0 _ -> accept R; q1 0,y -> q1 R; q1 1 -> q2 y L; q2 0,y -> q2 L; q2 x -> q0 R; q3 y -> q3 R; q3 _ -> accept R
